title: ConfigFile
description: On-disk settings. Every field optional so a partial file is valid.

allow_emulation.description: Allow installing x86_64 assets on Apple Silicon (via Rosetta).

auto_update.description: Refresh the package registry before `install` and `upgrade`.

emoji.description: Put an emoji icon in front of status lines on a terminal.

jobs.description: How many packages a batch install works on at once.

link_apps.description: Symlink `.app` bundles instead of copying them.

require_checksums.description: Refuse to install when the release publishes no checksum.

strip_quarantine.description: Remove the quarantine flag from code that passes signature checks.
